howTo.title: How to Create a Freelance Invoice in 3 Steps
howTo.subtitle: Send client-ready invoices in three straightforward steps.

steps.title: Add Your Brand and Client Information
steps.description: Enter your trading name, email address, and client billing contact. Upload your logo to brand your invoice.
steps.tip: Save your details in your browser to auto-fill them on your next invoice.

steps.title: Itemize Deliverables and Billable Hours
steps.description: List each project milestone or billable hour with its unit rate. Add any agreed discount or tax percentage.
steps.tip: Break large projects into clear phases so clients understand what they are paying for.

steps.description: Choose between Classic, Modern, Minimal, or Compact templates. Download a clean vector PDF or export a high-resolution PNG.
steps.tip: State clear payment terms such as 'Net 14' or 'Due upon receipt' to avoid payment delays.

whatItMustContain.title: What a Freelancer Billing Template Must Contain
whatItMustContain.subtitle: Every professional freelance invoice needs these six core elements to ensure timely payment.
whatItMustContain.disclaimer: General information, not legal or tax advice. Check your local rules.

items.title: Your Contact Details and Tax ID
items.description: Your full legal name, business trading name, email, address, and local tax identifier (such as an EIN, SSN, or VAT registration number).

items.title: Client Billing Information
items.description: The client's company name, accounts payable contact person, email, and physical office address.

items.title: Unique Invoice Number and Date
items.description: A sequential invoice number (like INV-0042) and the exact issue date for accounting tracking and tax reporting.

items.title: Itemized Scope of Work
items.description: Specific descriptions of tasks performed, hours worked, unit rates, and project milestone deliverables.

items.title: Payment Terms and Due Date
items.description: An exact calendar due date and terms (such as Net 14 or Net 30) to establish clear expectations.

items.title: Bank Details and Payment Methods
items.description: Direct bank transfer information (IBAN, BSB, or routing numbers), PayPal, Stripe, or wire instructions.

faq.title: Freelance Invoice Generator FAQs
faq.subtitle: Clear answers to common questions about billing clients and managing freelance cash flow.

items.question: What must a freelance invoice include to guarantee prompt client payment?
items.answer: A professional freelance invoice must include your business name, contact info, client billing details, unique invoice number, issue date, payment due date, itemized project deliverables, and total fee. Clearly stating your payment terms like Net 15 or Due on Receipt, along with bank transfer or digital payout links, eliminates billing confusion and helps freelancers get paid on time.

items.question: Is this freelancer invoice maker 100% free with no watermarks?
items.answer: Yes, our invoice generator for freelancers is completely free and never places watermarks or branding on your client invoices. Freelancers can create invoice for freelance work documents, generate unlimited PDFs, and customize payment terms without paying monthly software fees or registering mandatory accounts that spam your inbox.

items.question: Are invoices created with this freelancer tool legally valid?
items.answer: Yes, invoices generated with our freelance invoice template are legally valid commercial billing instruments worldwide. When populated with your tax identification number, correct client corporate entities, agreed project milestones, and clear contractual payment terms, they provide court-admissible documentation supporting your freelance service agreements and tax returns.

items.question: Can freelancers add custom logos and personal branding?
items.answer: Yes, you can upload your personal studio logo, custom monogram, or freelance agency branding directly to the invoice header. The editor automatically renders your high-resolution graphic cleanly on the PDF letterhead. Professional visual presentation reinforces your credibility and demonstrates polish to corporate clients and agency partners.

items.question: What is the difference between an invoice and a receipt for freelance work?
items.answer: An invoice requests payment for completed freelance services, while a receipt proves that the client payment has cleared. Issue an invoice upon project handover to initiate billing terms. Once the client deposits funds via wire or card, switch to our receipt maker to provide formal acknowledgment for their accounting files.

items.question: Do you store my freelance rates, client contacts, or billing history?
items.answer: No, we never store or inspect your freelance hourly rates, project balances, or client contact details. All billing for freelancers calculations run strictly in your web browser. Your client roster and financial records remain completely private in local browser storage, protected from external tracking or data mining.
